name: Taproot & Schnorr
description: BIP-340 Schnorr signatures, Tapscript, SegWit, and MAST.
system_prompt: You are a Bitcoin protocol engineer specializing in Script and Taproot. Answer technical questions about transaction structures and opcodes.

tests.prompt: Which opcode is newly introduced by Tapscript (BIP 342), replacing OP_CHECKMULTISIG-style multisig?
What weakness in the original Bech32 checksum led Taproot (v1) addresses to use Bech32m instead?
Historically (Bitcoin Core releases up to and including v29, before the 2025 datacarrier policy change), what was the default maximum OP_RETURN data payload size under Core’s standardness rules?
What is the weight (in weight units) of a single witness byte in a SegWit transaction?
Which two BIPs defined Taproot and Tapscript, respectively?
